items.name: chart_final
items.prompt: Edit the attached image. Remove the blue cube model and its shadow completely, and repaint that area of the parchment so the chart continues naturally: engraved sepia ink wave lines across the open sea and gentle depth-contour rings WITHOUT any numbers, matching the existing line-art style exactly. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the scroll, border, compass roses, depth ruler with tick marks only, empty label frame, red wax seal, the small engraved sailing ship, lighting and colours. Keep the upper 35% of the parchment clean EMPTY blank paper (only the border line). The result must be a single flat antique chart with NO 3D objects on it. ABSOLUTELY NO letters, words, numbers or pseudo-writing anywhere. No people, no hands, no watermark.
